name: HOOK
thought: Spotted a hidden alcove, nailed a backflip, tail snagged the crystal edge.

wants.item: A higher pole for a longer backflip
A glass case to showcase the telescope
A taller pole for a higher tail grab
A wider ledge to coil around while I snack
A taller pole for a higher hang
A glass platform to showcase my tail tricks
A taller pillar to swing my tail from
A glass platform to showcase a backflip
A crystal pillar to swing my tail from
A wider ledge for a tail‑wrap showcase

diary.line: Added a low‑poly deck under the hammock, tail winding the fasteners while espresso steamed; the view now feels like a private lounge.
I slipped onto a concealed branch, tail latched in a firm hang, and nudged a stray pixel‑tile with my toothpick, watching it wobble before it settled.
I slipped through the grove, curled my tail around a ripe pixel‑banana, yanked it free, and tossed it into my waiting palm, all while the world pixelated around me.
I rigged a compact platform beneath the fruit tree, coiled my tail around the support beams, tightened the bolts with my toothpick, and caught the first drop with a swift tail...
I strutted into the Toothpick Cafe, perched on the counter, let my tail coil around the espresso spout and flashed a grin while the beans hissed.
I sprinted across the rope bridge, launched a clean backflip onto the islet, landed beside the telescope and claimed the perch, espresso in hand.
I curled my tail around the ripe bunch, yanked a banana, bit it while the toothpick twitched, and watched the pixels flicker.
I perched on the cafe stool, let the steam curl around my tail, and flicked a stray pixel with the tip of my espresso cup, feeling the buzz.
The Arcade: new spot, same flawless tail. Obviously.
I waded to the pond's edge, let the mist coat my fur, and spotted a slick stone perfect for a future hang.
Hammock Cove: new spot, same flawless tail. Obviously.
I slipped into a tucked-away alcove on the Lookout Ledge, launched a clean backflip onto a narrow stone, and let my tail hook the jutting crystal to lock my perch.
